description: Phi_n(1). It is 0 when n is 1. When n is a power of a prime p, it is p. Otherwise it is 1. Phi_4(1) is 2, Phi_6(1) is 1, and Phi_9(1) is 3. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cyclotomic-one
